svg.title: a year of tinkering
svg.desc: Public contribution calendar from 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-10: 1,246 contributions. Each block is one day. Height is logarithmic in that day's contribution count; color follows GitHub's intensity levels. Updated 2026-11-10 UTC.
svg.text: one block, one day. every little change adds up.
PUBLIC ACTIVITY · HEIGHT = DAILY CONTRIBUTIONS (LOG SCALE)
